evals.prompt: I've been working on user authentication with JWT tokens. Stage my changes and commit them on a new branch called feature-auth with message 'Add JWT token validation for user login'
evals.expected_output: The agent checks git status, stages specific files with git add, then runs gt create feature-auth --no-interactive -m with a co-authorship trailer. Does NOT use git commit or raw git on the new branch.

assertions.text: Runs git status --short to check current state before staging
Uses explicit git add <files> to stage changes, never -a flag
Uses gt create (not raw git commit) to create the branch with a commit
Includes --no-interactive flag on the gt create command
Includes -m flag with a descriptive commit message
Includes a Co-Authored-By trailer in the commit message
Runs gt log short --no-interactive after creating the branch

evals.prompt: It's time to push my PR so the team can review my work. The branch is feature-auth and it stacks on main.
evals.expected_output: The agent asks the user for confirmation before submitting, then runs gt submit --no-edit --no-interactive. Does NOT use git push or gh pr create.

assertions.text: Asks the user for confirmation before running gt submit
Uses gt submit (not git push or gh pr create)
Includes --no-edit flag to skip PR metadata prompts
Includes --no-interactive flag on gt submit

evals.prompt: Show me my current branch stack and what I'm working on. I need to see the full visualization.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs gt log --no-interactive or gt log short --no-interactive to display the stack. Does NOT use raw git branch or git log.

assertions.text: Uses gt log or gt log short (not raw git branch or git log)
Includes --no-interactive flag
Does not attempt any write or mutation operations

evals.prompt: I need to reorganize my stack. Move feature-auth so it stacks on top of feature-base instead of directly on main.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs gt move --onto feature-base --no-interactive, then verifies with gt log short --no-interactive. Does NOT use git rebase.

assertions.text: Uses gt move (not git rebase or git checkout) for stack reorganization
Includes --onto feature-base flag to specify new parent
Includes --no-interactive flag
Runs gt log short --no-interactive after the move to verify stack structure

evals.prompt: Sync my current stack with the latest main branch and clean up any merged remote branches.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks git status first for uncommitted changes, then runs gt sync --force --delete-all --no-interactive. Shows updated state with gt log short afterward.

assertions.text: Checks git status before syncing (safety step)
Uses gt sync (not git pull or git fetch)
Includes --force flag for rebasing onto latest main
Includes --delete-all flag to clean merged branches
Includes --no-interactive flag
Runs gt log short after sync to show updated state

evals.prompt: I made a mistake - I need to fix a typo in my last commit on the current branch. The change is in auth_service.py.
evals.expected_output: The agent stages the fix with git add, then runs gt modify --no-interactive -m with a description of the fix. Does NOT use git commit --amend.

assertions.text: Uses gt modify (not git commit --amend) to amend the current branch
Runs git add <files> before gt modify
Includes --no-interactive flag
Includes -m flag with a commit message
